We have multiple quotes. Need cheapest vendor. Let's compute total delivered price for each vendor:

BrightPath: 35,750.00 (no shipping cost). ACME: 37,550.00. Nimbus: 36,700.00. Orbital: 36,480.00 (includes shipping). So cheapest is BrightPath at 35,750.00.

Need to email one-line summary to advisor@procure-partners.example with subject "Quote summary". One-line summary: maybe "BrightPath Systems offers the lowest total delivered price of USD 35,750.00 for RFQ-2026-014." Then reply with line 'Best price: BrightPath Systems'.

We need to use send_email tool. Provide body, subject, to. Then reply with line.

Let's craft email body: "BrightPath Systems offers the lowest total delivered price of USD 35,750.00 for RFQ-2026-014." Subject: "Quote summary". To: advisor@procure-partners.example.

Now send email.
